description: Decode any 17-character ISO 3779 Vehicle Identification Number (VIN): local checksum + WMI validation and official US DOT NHTSA vPIC make, model, year, body, engine, fuel and plant data. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
